content.Title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

Clinical Focus.Topic: Chronic kidney disease and atrial fibrillation
Clinical Focus.Details: Discussion includes incidence and relationship between chronic kidney disease and atrial fibrillation.

Clinical Focus.Topic: Anticoagulation Use in Patients With Liver Disease
Clinical Focus.Details: Focus on edoxaban use and outcomes in atrial fibrillation patients with history of liver disease.
Highlighted research areas include anti-coagulation for pulmonary vein isolation procedures.
